entries.zh: 睾丸（俗语，字面作“膳子”）；secondary: 伴侣们
entries.notes: 17 世纪西语 compañones 常义即睾丸，与闽南俗呼“×子”构词相符。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕比较级；更优胜者
entries.notes: L、H、M 三栏皆 [残]，仅据 R 栏 cǔ chiǎluck 及西语 Comparativo 推断。

entries.zh: 比较、相比；评比、比类（评+类）
打比方、用比喻议论；比喻之论
entries.en: to compare by way of illustration; analogical discourse

entries.zh: 品评人物、评论人的高下
entries.en: to compare and appraise persons, judge people's worth

entries.zh: 像……一样、正如（“亲像”，与……同法）
entries.en: just like, in the same manner as
to compare by analogy; analogical argument
entries.notes: L 栏缩写 U.S.（= i.e.，意即）展开依赖推断；四栏字面（譬論）清晰。

entries.zh: 譬喻、比喻（传教布道中常用作“比喻”讲道）
赴选、应试（比试较量谁更配得上）
entries.en: to present oneself for selection/examination, compete for preference
entries.notes: 西语“Comparar qual merece may”（较量谁更配）与“赴选”（赴考选）为语境推断的对合。

entries.zh: 圆规、规矩（量具）；引申为规矩、法度

entries.en: compatriots, people of the same native place

entries.zh: 音乐节拍之位、点板（按拍子的位置）
entries.en: the beat/time position in music, marking the measure
to compete, vie; to wager, bet
satisfaction, complacency; to be pleased with oneself

entries.zh: 令：组成、整理（使成一体）；亦有使、命令之义
entries.en: to put together, compose, arrange; to order, cause
entries.notes: Componer 与汉字“令”的对合不完全直截，释义兼取“组成/使令”两路。

entries.zh: 捻、捻合、搓合（捻聚成一体）
entries.en: to twist, pinch together; to twirl into one
entries.notes: Componer（使之合）对“捻”取搓捻合成义，依赖语境推断。
